scripts/two_turn_games.py dataset(player, n_per_group, seed, depth, threads, encounters=None) stores elite and boss fights (selfplay.make_specs varied decks, hallway group dropped, HP uniform 40-100% of max) played by the player two turns deep (depth_paired.run_guarded stepped fallback player with record=True, resumable partial under cache/, first-chunk pace logged) or one turn deep (sts.run search with the player's evaluator) as a registry dataset with real-outcome labels and no search values; its config is the dataset's identity (a smoke --max-nodes changes it). Measured pace 2026-11-03: 7.2 stepped fights per thread-minute at 400k nodes (job 0067's log).

scripts/two_turn_games.py dataset(player, n_per_group, seed, depth, threads, encounters=None) stores elite and boss fights (selfplay.make_specs varied decks, hallway group dropped, HP uniform 40-100% of max) played by the player two turns deep (depth_paired.run_guarded stepped fallback player with record=True, resumable partial under cache/, first-chunk pace logged) or one turn deep (sts.run search with the player's evaluator) as a registry dataset with real-outcome labels and no search values; its config is the dataset's identity (a smoke --max-nodes changes it). With encounters (--encounters, a comma list of boss encounters such as the_guardian,hexaghost) it stores boss fights only, n_per_group of them, on those encounters in turn with decks, seeds and HP unchanged; the list is part of the identity only when given, and an unknown name raises. With decks (--decks, a key of DECKS: varied, the training pool and the default, or held-out, selfplay.varied_held_out_deck: varied decks holding at least two held-out cards, Demon Form in about 40%) the decks are drawn from that kind, recorded as the config's setups. finetune.py takes source {kind: two-turn|one-turn, player, encounters (optional), decks (optional)} instead of content and uses the varied kind for the Ironclad validation and pool; two_turn_round.py arm fine-tunes then reads the run one turn deep @hpb0.01 on the cell gauntlet with the protocol. Measured pace 2026-11-03: 7.2 stepped fights per thread-minute at 400k nodes (job 0067's log).
